fields.statement: Change set 'The daemon behaves the same' (01M6JY2): the code already does what its title says. internal/api/daemon_startstop.go has one daemonArgs = [daemon --autonomous], and both the systemd unit's ExecStart and the Rex tab use it, since #200. daemon-install.txtar and daemon-start-stop.txtar each grep for 'daemon --autonomous'. The one real difference between service and tab is the environment. On the VM, PATH and TMPDIR come from a drop-in written by hand (~/.config/systemd/user/rhiza-rhiza.service.d/env.conf), and daemon install doesn't write it. So a fresh install would run agents with systemd's bare PATH, unlike the tab. What should this change set's leaves cover?
